title: Only categories with sales show, Uncategorized first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have two new categories for this test, category A named Aaa Test Category and category B named Zzz Test Category, with no matrix.
  • Have a third new category for this test, category C, with no sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with parts in category A, category B and Uncategorized, each cost $100.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • Rows read Uncategorized, category A, category B, in that order.
  • Category C has no row.
